channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA MINPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
Issued at 05:00 AM 14 November 2026

Light to Moderate rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #SurigaoDelNorte(SanFrancisco, Placer), #SurigaoDelSur(Hinatuan, Lanuza) and #AgusanDelSur(Loreto).

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #SurigaoDelNorte(SurigaoCity, Sison and TaganaAn) and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
